candidates.excerpt: YSRCP MLC Anantha Babu and his wife Lakshmi Durga, the main accused in the murder of Dalit driver V. Subrahmanyam in Kakinada, suffered a setback in the Supreme Court.

candidates.title: Bengaluru: Petrol Pump Catches Fire After Jaguar Car Crashes Into It
candidates.excerpt: A Jaguar car rammed into a fuel station in Bengaluru, sparking a massive fire. The occupants of the car and the fuel station staff narrowly escaped with their lives, while a worker was injured in the fire.

candidates.title: Proof of 21 'compromised transfers', 11 policy changes part of CBI's Punjab file
candidates.excerpt: CBI has obtained evidence related to compromised transfers involving 21 senior officials in Punjab government and police. The probe focuses on a cash-for-postings scam connected to OSD to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. Allegations include various requests for administrative favors and transfer requests surrounding certain officers. The investigation involves interactions with individuals linked to tender manipulations across the state.

candidates.title: What is PERM? Why Trump suspended Microsoft and Indian IT firms from green-card programme
candidates.excerpt: Vice President JD Vance announced the move on Thursday (October 8), accusing companies of using foreign-worker programmes at the expense of US employees.

candidates.title: IAF celebrates its 94-year-old glorious journey
candidates.excerpt: Indian Air Force celebrated its 94th anniversary at Hindon Air Force Station showcasing its historical significance. The event featured aerobatics by the vintage Tiger Moth and a display of military aircraft. IAF Chief ACM Singh emphasized the importance of operational preparedness and joint operations with the Army and Navy. PM Narendra Modi and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended the courage and dedication of IAF personnel.

candidates.title: Microsoft Defends H-1B Visa Use After US Suspends Green Card Filings
candidates.excerpt: The statement came on Thursday hours after Vice President J D Vance suspended Microsoft from a programme to apply for green cards for foreign workers, accusing it of abusing the system.
